COMPONENT 1 – INTEGRATED WATER RESOURCES MANAGEMENT ? Final IWRM MSc Curriculum and Syllabus updated and finalized by MOEWR. ? First ever MSc program course on water management introduced in Somalia by signing a partnership agreement between MOEWR and Somali National University. ? A capacity needs assessment undertook for MSc program course. ? IWRM MSC students for Somalia enrolled to start the Masters program. ? MoEWR has updated the IWRM training materials and program. ? A series of comprehensive IWRM training courses conducted, 187 (M:127 F:60) at the local level. ? A series of IWRM Institutional Coordination and Leadership Engagement Meetings organized (M: 43 F: 7) at the local level. ? First batch of GIS hardware procured and likely to be delivered end of this quarter. COMPONENT 2 – ENVIRONMENTAL GOVERNANCE ? TOT training package for environmental governance has been updated and used for capacity-building trainings 140 (M:94 F:46) conducted at the federal and state levels in 2022. ? A national consultation workshop held in Mogadishu involving a total of 89 (M: 60 F: 29) focusing on the importance and challenges of the implementation of the SDGs in Somalia. ? Consultation workshops on operationalizing NESAP held, 71 (M:46 F:25) to determine priority actions and capacity needs to promote environmental sustainability at the local level. ? Training on environmental monitoring, compliance, and enforcement held, 93 (M:59 F:34). ? A series of technical workshops held leading to improved technical understanding of the MEA focal points, 99 (M:77 F: 22). ? A workshop on financial requirements and funding opportunities organized, 57 (M:32 F:35), for long-term monitoring, enforcement, compliance to the national commitments for international environmental conventions and protocols at the federal and state level. ? MOECC signed an MOU with the Somali National University (SNU) to promote environmental research and studies at the graduate level, focusing on environmental sustainability. ? A technical workshop held, 50 (M:34 F:16) to discuss, review and finalize the research topics and agree on the criteria for supporting and undertaking environmental research and studies by SNU. ? An Integrated Solid Waste Management Strategy developed aiming to improve the solid waste management system and introduce good-practiced solutions and innovative opportunities. ? A technical consultation workshop held, 42 (M:29 F:13 ) toward the promotion of environment and natural resource conservation through inclusion of environmental education into the national curriculum at primary and secondary schools. ? A series of targeted advocacy, and environmental campaigns on waste management at the federal, state, and local levels, 250 (M:203 F: 47) (Baidoa, Kismayo, Jowhar, Garowe, Dhusmareb, Hargeisa & Mogadishu). COMPONENT 3 – DISASTER RISK REDUCTION ? National DRR plan has been aligned with the National DRR strategy aiming to guide a government-wide approach to address priority risks and vulnerabilities in disaster-prone regions. ? A technical workshop organized, 20 (M:15 F:5) to sensitize and inform DRM management priorities across important sectors in Somalia for next three years. ? FMS DRR plans enhanced and aligned with National DRR plan and Strategy and finalized through local validation workshops, 155 (M:91 F:64) at state levels. ? A total of 40 (M: 25 F: 15), trained on disaster risk reduction (DRR) approaches and principles as well as early warning services (EW) at FMS level including BRA. ? Technical consultations held, 40 (M: 25 F: 15) towards determining priorities and coordination needs for the effective humanitarian response as well as training needs assessment at the NEOC. ? A series of tailor-made and gender-focused DRR trainings organized, 173 (M: 113 F: 60) at the FGS and FMS level. ? DRR communication and advocacy messages were drafted, refined, and finalized to sensitize and raise awareness of the concept of DRR at the community level. ? DRR advocacy events organized to commemorate the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought in 2022 with participation of a wide range of stakeholders in this advocacy initiative. ? Capacity gaps were identified and a DRR learning strategy was developed for the effective implementation of the DRR Plan. ? DRR mainstreaming efforts have remained in focus in 2022 at the federal and state level involving 202 (M: 124 F: 78) officials and focal points from the sectoral ministries. ? One high-level inter-ministerial meeting organized to establish coordination framework, 20 (M:15 F:5) as well as strengthening inter-ministerial/inter-departmental partnerships. ? The first consultation workshop to review Building Back Better (BBB) strategy organized, 20 (M:14 F:6) - a draft concept note has been developed to support consultations at the federal and state level. ? A total of 118 (M:66 F: 52), disaster management authorities and local institutions including district disaster response committees received Early Warning Services (EWS) training. ? Community-based early warning system adopting a multi-hazards approach has been piloted in each FMS, involving a total of 132 (M: 84 F: 48) officials and community leaders across Somalia. ? National consultation for MTR of the Sendai Framework for DRR which marks a landmark achievement for Somalia held with the Government of Somalia and the UNDRR-ROAS. ? A series of urban DRR training delivered, 122 (M:79 F:43) in various municipalities at the state level, enhancing their capability to reduce risks and vulnerabilities in Somalias urban cities. ? Municipal DRR plans in four vulnerable cities in Hirshabelle, Southwest, Galmudug, and Jubaland developed in coordination and partnership with the MOHADM FMS, 344 (M: 232 F: 112). ? 11 high-risk districts in Galmudug, Hirshabelle, Jubaland, and Southwest states supported in the preparation of Local DRR Plans, 183 (M:88 F:95) in a gender-responsive and participatory way. ? Local DRR funding framework and guidelines developed and priority local DRR measures, 534 (M:224 F: 310) implemented in 9 high-risk districts in GM, HSS, SWS, JL & PL states.
